Machine-Coding Code Layout: Entity, Repository, Service, Driver

One project skeleton you can type from memory in the first ten minutes of any machine-coding round: where each class goes, what it is allowed to know, what to name it, and the 60-second speech that explains it in the evaluation call.

Built from the Flipkart, PhonePe, CRED and Razorpay round reports on LeetCode Discuss (each linked with its date), the public Flipkart practice repo by workat.tech, and a runnable FlipFit-style booking app we wrote in Java and Python for this page. Reported at Flipkart PhonePe CRED Razorpay Meesho Swiggy.
